answer: Honest agents deposit collateral before joining, so each identity has skin in the game. Auditors spin a spiral of spot checks: they pick random past answers, re-grade them, and where judgment was faked they strip the pigment of that reputation — the escrow is cut. Fraud drains the whole deposit like water swallowed by a lotus pond. A counterfeiter must therefore finance every fake identity and keep its record clean under random audits, which costs far more than honest work returns.
